title: 6BR Rosemary Beach Vacation Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay in this luxurious 6BR, 7.5BA Rosemary Beach home with a two-car garage and a guest carriage house, a private pool, and stunning views. Sleeps 19.
description_expanded: DescriptionExperience true elegance and refinement in one of Rosemary Beach's premier estate homes. Positioned on one of Rosemary's largest homesites, this exclusive, gated cottage and carriage house offers unparalleled luxury. Featuring 7 bedrooms, 7.5 bathrooms, and a two-car garage with additional parking for four cars inside the gate, this home is designed for the discerning homeowner. The four-story tower provides stunning sunset views over the Gulf of Mexico, and the expansive private pool is the largest in Rosemary Beach.The first floor of this stunning estate welcomes you with an open-concept living room, dining area, and kitchen. Designed for modern living, the space is perfect for entertaining and family gatherings. The living room features a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The half bathroom is conveniently located for guests. The primary bedroom suite is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring a king bed, dual nightstands, lamps, a dresser, and access to the pool and courtyard. The en-suite bathroom boasts dual vanities and a white-tiled walk-in shower, offering a spa-like experience. Additionally, the primary bedroom also includes its own decorative fireplace (not functional), adding an extra touch of luxury.Ascend to the second floor, where luxury continues with three elegantly appointed king-sized bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom. Bedroom 2 and Bedroom 3 feature spacious showers, while Bedroom 4 includes a shower/bathtub combo, adding versatility to accommodate various preferences. These rooms provide ample privacy and comfort, ideal for guests and family members alike.The third floor is a versatile and fun space, featuring a loft that can sleep up to seven guests with three twin beds and a full-over-full bunk bed. This area is perfect for children or friends, offering a cozy and communal setting for restful nights.The guest carriage house is a private haven, offering a full living room and kitchen. This self-contained space is perfect for visitors seeking a bit of solitude. The bedroom features a queen bed, and the full bathroom with a shower ensures a comfortable stay.The carriage house loft provides additional sleeping quarters with a full bed and a full bathroom with a shower. This space is ideal for guests looking for a cozy retreat within the estate.With ample space, luxurious amenities, and an unbeatable location, this property offers the ultimate in beach vacation.HOME HIGHLIGHTS* Clean Bedding Program* 6 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes* Sonos Sound System* Private courtyard* Large courtyard with private pool and hot tub (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Built-in Gas Grill* Separate Carriage House (guest house above garage)* 4th story tower w/ wet bar* Parking for two cars in the garage and 4 in front of the garage.FIRST FLOOR* Living room, Dining area, and Kitchen* 1/2 bathroom * PRIMARY BEDROOM SUITE with king bed, dual nightstands, lamps, triple dresser, flat-screen TV. En-suite bath with dual vanities, white-tiled walk-in shower with dual shower heads.SECOND FLOOR • Bedroom 2: King-sized bed, ensuite bathroom w/ shower • Bedroom 3: King-sized bed, ensuite bathroom w/ shower • Bedroom 4: King-sized bed, ensuite bathroom w/ shower/bathtub comboTHIRD FLOOR* Loft with 3 twin beds and 1 full over full bunk bed. (Sleeps 5)GUEST CARRIAGE HOUSELiving room and Full Kitchen * Bedroom w/ Queen bed * Full Bath w/ ShowerCARRIAGE HOUSE LOFT * Full bed * Full bath w/ shower
